name: shalcon-demo-first-outbound-engine
description: Demo-first outbound engine for Shalcon Intelligence

scripts.dev:web: npm run prepare:templates && npm --workspace @shalcon/web run dev
scripts.dev:runner: cd apps/local-runner && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m shalcon_runner run
scripts.runner:once: cd apps/local-runner && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m shalcon_runner once
scripts.runner:health: cd apps/local-runner && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m shalcon_runner health
scripts.build: npm run prepare:templates && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:templates && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:python: cd apps/local-runner && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest tests -q
scripts.test:phase0:offline: npm run typecheck:foundation && npm run test:python && npm run test:phase0:audit
